findings.text: Companies House records the status as active.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for this company.
Accounts are not overdue; they were last made up to 28 February 2026 and the next accounts are due 26 August 2027.
The confirmation statement is not overdue; it was last made up to 18 June 2026 and the next is due 2 July 2027.
There are 2 outstanding and 7 satisfied charges registered, 9 in total, with none part-satisfied.
The company has 11 current officers, comprising 10 directors and 1 other officer.
No current person with significant control is on record, although this does not prove the company has no owner.
Across the 5 current directors checked, 83 other companies were found, and directors are linked to a company in an insolvency process; only the first 5 of 10 current directors were checked.

headline.text: The company is active, incorporated on 27 November 1947, with accounts and confirmation statement not overdue, 2 outstanding charges, and no insolvency record held.
